subject: Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan Revision
overview: The subcommittee met to review and revise the district's 38-page Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan. Members discussed out-of-school cyberbullying, reporting flowcharts, and definition sections, delegating specific drafting tasks for a subsequent meeting.

items.title: Meeting Opening and Open Meeting Law Guidance
items.summary: Subcommittee Chair Paul Ruseau opened the meeting and shared guidance from the Attorney General's office requiring all substantive policy revisions to take place during public meetings rather than through shared document editing.

items.title: Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan Revision
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed the district's Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan line-by-line, discussing out-of-school cyberbullying jurisdiction, expanded definitions for video sharing and social media, investigation timelines, and reporting flowcharts.

items.title: Work Assignments and Next Meeting Scheduling
items.summary: Members assigned revision tasks—including updating the reporting flowchart, drafting district educational obligations, and consolidating duplicate definitions—and scheduled their next meeting for March 21, 2023.
